retro.free: {n} free on the games disk · saves sync to every device

stream.title: 3DS streams from the server
stream.s1: Open Moonlight (phone: Play Store, PC: moonlight-stream.org).
stream.s2: Add host {host} (or "games" on the tailnet) and pair once.
stream.s3: Pick Azahar (3DS): every 3DS game here is in its list, saves are shared.

get.lead: Free homebrew games, shared by their makers (Homebrew Hub, Retrobrews). One tap adds a game to the library.

up.title: Upload game files
up.types: Takes {exts}. A picture with the same name becomes its cover.
up.bios: Only Sega CD and Saturn need one; PlayStation and DS run better with one. Replaces the current BIOS. {has}

share.title: Or copy them over the network
share.body: Drop files into the folder for their console on the games share (Samba, user max).

retro.legal: Commercial games: use dumps of cartridges and discs you own.
